descriptionPlain:
VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization.  Large banks, aspiring fintechs, and growing merchants embed our universal token vault into their technology stack to manage the complexities of payment data tokenization across processors and networks, open banking, card issuance, omnichannel loyalty, PCI compliance, payment orchestration, and more. We empower our clients and partners by tokenizing sensitive payment data, limiting compliance scope, and consolidating payments to unlock revenue and business opportunities. 
VGS provides processor-agnostic tokenization solutions via secure universal token vaults, iframes, mobile SDKs, tokenization proxies, APIs, and data orchestration tooling to support payment acceptance, card issuance, PII and bank account tokenization, and other payments value-added services. Some of the use cases we enable include multi-processor Network Tokenization, Account Updater, payment orchestration, secure settlement file processing, 3DS, and Risk provider connectivity.
VGS is looking for a Senior HR Business Partner who can pair trusted counsel with hands-on execution. You will support leaders and employees across technical and business functions, translate business priorities into practical people plans, and help VGS build healthy, accountable teams through change and growth.
This is a broad generalist role for an experienced partner who is equally comfortable advising a leader on organization design, coaching a manager through a difficult performance conversation, reviewing people data, and driving a people program to completion. You will support Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Go-to-Market, or other technical teams in a scaling technology company.
We are prioritizing candidates based in the Bay Area to support in-person partnership with leadership teams.

lists.text: What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...
lists.content:
• Business partnership and organization effectiveness. Build a deep understanding of assigned teams, their goals, and their operating context. Advise leaders on organization design, role clarity, team effectiveness, workforce planning, spans and layers, and talent priorities.

  • Manager coaching and employee relations. Serve as a first point of contact for managers and employees. Coach leaders through performance, feedback, conflict, attendance, accommodations, leaves, conduct, and workplace concerns; conduct or support fair, timely investigations; and partner with Legal or outside counsel when appropriate.

  • Performance and talent management. Lead the business-facing work for performance reviews, goal setting, talent reviews, succession planning, development planning, promotions, and corrective action. Help managers raise the quality and consistency of feedback and talent decisions.

  • Compensation and leveling. Partner with People leadership and Finance on compensation planning, job leveling, pay decisions, promotions, and retention actions. Apply established frameworks consistently and identify where clearer guidance or calibration is needed.

  • Organizational change. Plan and execute reorganizations, leadership transitions, and other changes with sound judgment, clear communication, careful documentation, and respect for the employee experience. Support compliant and well-coordinated offboarding and termination processes.

  • Employee experience and culture. Maintain an intentional listening cadence through employee check-ins, office hours, focus groups, and targeted outreach. Surface themes, distinguish individual concerns from systemic issues, and partner with leaders on practical actions.

  • People programs and operations. Translate company-wide programs and policies into effective execution within the business. Partner with People Operations and Recruiting across hiring, onboarding, engagement, mobility, leaves, and offboarding; improve processes where ownership or handoffs are unclear.

  • Insights and risk management. Use workforce data and qualitative signals to identify trends in attrition, engagement, performance, manager effectiveness, and organizational health. Provide leaders with clear recommendations while maintaining accurate, confidential case documentation and consistent practices.

lists.text: What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...
lists.content:
• 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including substantial experience in an HRBP, People Partner, or broad HR generalist role supporting leaders and employees.

  • Demonstrated success advising senior leaders and coaching managers through complex employee relations, performance, organizational, and talent decisions.

  • Working knowledge of California and multi-state U.S. employment practices, with the judgment to recognize when specialized legal guidance is needed.

  • Experience owning or materially contributing to core people cycles such as performance reviews, compensation planning, promotions, talent reviews, engagement, and workforce planning.

  • Strong business acumen and analytical skill; able to connect people data and employee feedback to operating priorities and concrete recommendations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to adapt your approach across employees, managers, and executives.

  • Sound judgment, discretion, and consistency when handling sensitive information and high-stakes decisions.

  • A practical, low-ego operating style: organized, responsive, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to move between strategic advice and detailed execution.

  • Exposure to workforce planning and headcount management processes

• Leaders receive timely, clear, and business-grounded advice—and become more capable people managers over time.

  • Employee matters are handled consistently, respectfully, and with appropriate urgency, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Talent, performance, compensation, and organizational decisions are better calibrated and supported by useful data and clear frameworks.

  • People programs land effectively within supported teams, with strong cross-functional coordination and fewer ownership gaps.

  • Emerging organizational risks and employee themes are identified early and translated into practical action.

descriptionPlain:
About VGS
VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.
 

 
About the Role
Agentic commerce is moving faster than almost any other area in payments, and VGS is building Agentic Tokens and the infrastructure behind them. The Sr. Partnerships Manager - Agentic, Fintech and Emerging Partnerships will work closely with the Head of Wallets & PSPs, Strategic Partnerships to advance our agentic initiatives, build and manage PSP & Wallet partnerships, and develop new opportunities across fintech and emerging payments.
This role blends hands-on partnership management with market intelligence. You'll help turn partner opportunities into launches and bring partner and market signals back to Sales, Product, and Marketing so that VGS stays ahead as payment workflows evolve.
 

 
What You’ll Do
Own growth plans for priority agentic, fintech, and emerging partnerships, working closely with the Head of Wallets & PSPs, Strategic Partnerships.
Build and manage PSP & Wallet relationships, and work with Product, Engineering, and Ops to expand PSP & Wallet connections and move integrations forward.
Identify new product, co-build, and revenue opportunities across agentic initiatives and the broader partner portfolio, and work with relationship leads and internal teams to turn them into launches.
Coordinate cross-functional execution, including launch plans, PSP integration requirements, card network dependencies, timelines, and open items.
Serve as a strategic point of contact for partner leadership, preparing exec-level business reviews and roadmap discussions across agentic and PSP partnerships.
Track trends across AI agents, agent platforms, fintech, card network agentic programs, network tokenization, wallets, and PSPs, and turn them into short, regular briefings and recommendations for GTM, Product, and leadership.
Build a repeatable feedback loop that brings partner and market signals into Sales, Product, and Marketing, such as integration needs, competitive moves, requested features, and emerging use cases.
Work with the Sales team to qualify and prioritize opportunities across PSPs, agentic companies, fintech, and emerging payment workflows.
Help shape positioning, messaging, and packaging for agentic and payments offerings with Product and Marketing.
Assess and prioritize inbound partner opportunities, and contribute to partnerships planning across the Product, Direct Revenue, and Referral/Channel opportunity categories.
 

 
What You Bring
6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, strategy, or product-adjacent roles in payments, fintech, PSPs, AI/developer platforms, or agentic companies
Hands-on knowledge of payments, including network tokenization, card networks, wallets, and PSPs
A record of growing strategic partnerships with large, complex counterparts and managing ongoing partner relationships
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn a flood of information into a clear point of view and recommendation
Comfort with technical conversations and with working alongside engineers and partner technical teams to move integrations and launches forward
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including at the exec level
A self-starter mindset, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-changing landscape
Nice to Have:
Experience with agentic commerce and agentic network tokenization, including network token use in agent-led payment flows
Experience building internal intelligence or insights programs
Familiarity with data security, PCI, and privacy requirements
We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.
